All fixed chassis, deck, steps, tank, mudflaps and load must END ABOVE HUB LINE; only road tires below hubs. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Visible short bonnet with distinct radiator housing, blunt bumper, headlamp and fender; round front arches following tire clearance; small rectangular mirrors on short rigid brackets near door.
